verdict.rationale: Canny documents its own programmatic surfaces: an API Reference page exists, and the official MCP server lets users update statuses, link deals, organize requests and reply to customers. Nothing in the pack shows these cover everything the UI can do, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence of API/UI feature parity, endpoint coverage details from the API reference, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Update statuses, link deals, organize requests, and reply to customers.
official MCP server documented at https://canny.io/features/mcp
